**3. Factual errors in the proposed dispositions**

- **Brief's own premise is wrong:** not every Instron header prints 5.000 in. Eight reports show 5.000 / 0.236 / 1.000 / 2.000 in. The §3.5 "1006 MPa at 11.9 %" specimen was a 6.0 mm gauge; the 127 mm sibling (Fe-SMA-FC spool 19) gave 478 MPa at 0.5 %. Say "every test reported", then make it true.
- **#6:** the 1340/1390 °C solvi are artifacts — scripts request 'LIQUID:L', pycalphad names it 'LIQUID', liquid was silently dropped (results log "absent : LIQUID:L"). With liquid: mpea-02b 1300 °C = 96 % α + 3.7 % liquid; PrecHiMn 1340 °C = 100 % liquid. "Databases disagree on the solidus" is the same artifact; 1330 vs 1340 °C inconsistency; wire was actually exposed at 1250 and 1300 °C (spools 13/14; oct-11-25 spool 6) — disclose. PrecHiMn re-entrant γ above 1200 °C needs higher pdens before quoting.
- **#1:** "unchanged" is false (α 37→34 %, gauge, strain rate, Table 2 n=1→3, AGG-pattern sentence, Si, composition range, "identical processing", §3.1 assignment). Driving-force mechanism was withdrawn, not re-based. SME test is one condition, not "any".
- **#3:** Ref-18 "continuous cooling / 600 °C step" and the MMTA 2024 "Kassel protocol" are unverified (paywalled/abstract only). The record holds three AGG schedules; the 10/11/25 wire run had no 900 °C step, and Fig. 1d (0.36 mm) is by diameter that run. §3.5 ¶4 "duplex on both sides" contradicts §3.4.
- **#4:** Fig. 3 is the authors' plot, byte-identical to submission, not a machine plot; no heating test exists in the eight reports; Aug-2026 replicate run omitted from "repeated tests".
- **#7:** 40-min rod record sits in a file headed 697-7 (benchmark) — publish only on Song's written confirmation; confirmed-LLM spools 15/16/19 and oct-11-25 spool 2 (51.3 %) omitted; "single three-cycle-plus-age specimen" false; Fig. 1c section ≈0.3 mm = wire; "no Rietveld possible" undocumented.
- **#8:** paper "named", never "promised" calorimetry; specimen is 1200 °C / 4 fpm strand anneal, not a 1 min hold; L122/L204 ("equilibrium state at 1200 °C") contradict L206 (open since 08-05).
- **#2/#5:** "demonstrated pre-screen" was retrospective; Limitation 2's "instructing it to consult thermodynamic data" unsupported by §2.1; §1 "trained on 200 papers" vs 76 sources; §3.5 "eight conditions of Table 2" miscount.
